svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="OinDn8t0HYK63t0Cmpcx" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="2171" dy="1523" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '20px'}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant RL as rateLimiter<br/>(middleware)
 participant Redis as Redis
 participant Ctrl as Auth Controller
 participant Svc as Auth Service
 participant Prisma as Prisma
 participant DB as PostgreSQL

 C->>+RL: POST /v1/auth/login<br/>{ email, password }

 RL->>+Redis: INCR rl:login:per-minute:ip:<ip><br/>INCR rl:login:per-hour:ip:<ip>
 Note over RL,Redis: Lua script — atomic<br/>INCR + EXPIRE
 Redis-->>-RL: counts

 alt over 10/min or 50/hour
 RL-->>C: 429 Too Many Requests<br/>Retry-After: <ttl>
 else within limits
 RL->>+Ctrl: forward request
 Ctrl->>Ctrl: validate(LoginDto)

 Ctrl->>+Svc: login(email, password)

 Svc->>+Prisma: user.findUnique({ email })
 Prisma->>+DB: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1
 DB-->>-Prisma: user row
 Prisma-->>-Svc: user

 Note over Svc: bcrypt.compare<br/>password vs user.password_hash
 Svc->>Svc: comparePassword(password, user.passwordHash)

 Note over Svc: JWT signing<br/>access + refresh
 Svc->>Svc: issueTokens(id, role)

 Svc->>+Prisma: refreshToken.create({ userId, tokenHash, expiresAt })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc->>+Prisma: auditLog.create({ userId, event: user.login })
 Prisma->>+DB: INSERT INTO auth.audit_logs (...)
 DB-->>-Prisma: ack
 Prisma-->>-Svc: ack

 Svc-->>-Ctrl: { accessToken, refreshToken }
 Ctrl-->>-C: 200 OK<br/>{ accessToken }<br/>Set-Cookie: refreshToken (HttpOnly, Secure)
 end
